description.zh: 待执行命令的实例ID。N的范围：1~10
description.en: The instance ID of the instance on which the command is to be executed. Valid values of N: 1 to 10.

description.zh:
待卸载的APP名称
最大长度为1024字节，只支持大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、点（.）、斜线（/）、冒号（:）、中划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the application to uninstall. The name can be up to 1024 bytes in length and can contain uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), periods (.), forward slashes (/), colons (:), and hyphens (-).
